evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton enacts authority by unilaterally setting a recurring mandate and framing compliance as a condition of possession — a rank-based directive, not a proposal for consensus.
The summary records a single named owner for the decision, enacting hierarchical allocation of responsibility rather than collective or reciprocal distribution.

mints.name: MandateAsPossession

mints.theme: Authority frames an unrehearsed contingency as something you simply do not have, collapsing compliance into existence
